import numpy as np
# Find DTG max in 450-800 C range
mask = (x >= 450) & (x <= 800)
if np.any(mask):
    idx_max = np.argmax(y2[mask])
    x_peak = x[mask][idx_max]
    y2_peak = y2[mask][idx_max]
    # Get local slope at peak from TG curve
    # Use gradient of y1 w.r.t x
    grad = np.gradient(y1, x)
    # Find index closest to x_peak
    i_peak = np.argmin(np.abs(x - x_peak))
    slope = grad[i_peak]
    # Baseline: horizontal line at weight at 500 C
    y_base = np.interp(500, x, y1)
    # Tangent line: y = y1[i_peak] + slope * (x - x_peak)
    # Intersection with baseline: y_base = y1[i_peak] + slope * (t_onset - x_peak)
    if slope != 0:
        t_onset = x_peak + (y_base - y1[i_peak]) / slope
        marks.append({"type": "vline", "x": float(t_onset), "text": f"Onset {t_onset:.1f} °C"})
